module.purpose: Defines the client/server server-function builder, middleware execution pipeline, validator execution, and associated TypeScript contracts for TanStack Start.
module.summary: This module constructs typed server-function builders that preserve HTTP method, validators, middleware, extracted client handlers, and server handlers across client and server environments. It executes flattened middleware chains with environment-specific handlers, validates server inputs, merges contexts and headers safely, propagates redirects and responses, prevents duplicate request middleware execution, and exposes extensive generic types describing inputs, outputs, serialization, middleware composition, and fetcher behavior.
module.businessContext: Supports application server functions and request middleware in TanStack Start. Failures can break client-to-server calls, validation, redirects, context propagation, or HTTP method enforcement.
